title: History of Warcraft
wikitext:
The '''History of Warcraft''' is a part of the [[Warcraft universe|''Warcraft'' universe]]. It is a comprehensive account of Warcraft's history created by [[Blizzard Entertainment]] as background information to the ''[[World of Warcraft]]'' universe.<ref name="lore">{{Ref web|url=http://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/story/index.html#lore|title=History of Warcraft Index|publisher=[[Blizzard Entertainment]]|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20100207204945/https://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/story/index.html#Lore|archivedate=2010-02-07}}</ref> The majority of the text was not newly written but instead copied from the earlier ''Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos Game Manual'' and ''World of Warcraft: Game Manual''. The full text was available on the official [https://web.archive.org/web/20100207204945/https://www.worldofwarcraft.com/info/story/ ''World of Warcraft'' site]. Additionally, all chapters can be read below or within the game itself as [[:Category:Readable objects|in-game books]].

The compendium was first released on July 16, 2004.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20040722085445/http://www.worldofwarcraft.com Archived page]</ref>
